title: Contacts
description: Show the people in a contact file as person cards, quotes, a table or a list.
demoHtml:
<vcf-render contact-data="BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:Doe;John;;;
FN:John Doe
ORG:Example Corp
TITLE:Director of Teaching and Learning
TEL;TYPE=WORK,VOICE:(111) 555-1212
EMAIL;TYPE=PREF,INTERNET:john.doe@example.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;42 Plantation St.;Baytown;LA;30314;United States of America
URL:https://hax.psu.edu/
NOTE:Supports faculty adopting open courseware.
END:VCARD" display-as="cards"></vcf-render>

attributes.name: data-source
attributes.description: URL of the .vcf file, usually one uploaded to the site's files.

attributes.name: contact-data
attributes.description: Contact file contents, for rendering without a fetch.

attributes.name: display-as
attributes.description: How to present the contacts: cards, quotes, table or list.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Caption for the table and a heading for the other modes.

attributes.name: debounce-delay
attributes.description: Delay in ms before a data-source change triggers a load. Exposed mainly so tests can shrink it; the default matches csv-render.

gizmo.title: Contacts
gizmo.description: Show the people in a contact file as person cards, quotes, a table or a list.

configure.title: Contact file
configure.description: Upload or choose a .vcf contact file. Its cards are read in the browser.

configure.title: Display as
configure.description: How to present what the file contains.

configure.title: Heading
configure.description: Shown above the contacts, and as the table caption.
